Visualise Palettes or Colour Vectors

Source: R/color.R
pal_show.Rd

Display palettes as horizontal colour bars (ggplot) or a gt table with colour swatches. Use output = "gg" for the Plots pane or output = "gt" for the Viewer pane.

Usage

pal_show(
  palette = NULL,
  n = NULL,
  pattern = NULL,
  type = c("all", "discrete", "continuous"),
  max_colors = 20,
  index = NULL,
  output = c("gt", "gg", "console"),
  label = TRUE,
  label_size = 3,
  ncol = NULL
)

Arguments

palette

Character vector of palette names (e.g. "lancet"), a colour vector (hex codes or named colours), or NULL to show all palettes matching pattern/type. Named colour vectors (e.g. pal_paraSC) use valid names as labels and hex codes for missing or whitespace-only names. Repeated palette names are displayed once, in first-occurrence order; repeated literal colours are preserved. Factors, classed vectors, matrices and data frames are not supported.

n

Positive whole number of colours to preview from each palette. Continuous palettes are sampled evenly across their full range; a single colour uses the middle of the palette. Discrete palettes and untyped colour vectors take colours from the front and interpolate when more are requested than are available. max_colors caps how many are drawn. Default NULL uses the native colour count before the display cap.

pattern

Single non-missing regex string to filter palette names (e.g. "^nord"). Default NULL does not filter by name.

type

Filter by type: "all", "discrete", or "continuous".

max_colors

Positive whole number limiting displayed colours per palette, or Inf for no display cap. Default 20.

index

Non-empty vector of unique positive whole-number indices after filtering. Out-of-range values are ignored; an empty selection is an error.

output

Output format: "gt" (default) for a gt table, "gg" for a ggplot, or "console" for terminal output.

label

Logical. For output = "gg" in colour vector mode, whether to show hex/name labels on tiles. Default TRUE. Does not change gt tables or console output.

label_size

Positive finite number. Tile-label text size for output = "gg" in colour vector mode. Default 3.

ncol

Positive whole number of columns for output = "gg" in colour vector mode. Default NULL puts every displayed colour on a single row.

Value

A ggplot or gt object returned visibly for automatic display. Console output prints and invisibly returns the displayed data.

Details

When palette is a character vector of valid colour specifications (hex codes like "#FF0000" or named R colours like "red") rather than palette names, the function automatically switches to colour vector mode: it displays the colours directly as a single-row colour bar (ggplot) with hex labels, similar to show_color() but as a publication-ready plot.

See also

Other colour palettes: pal_bar, pal_get(), pal_heat, pal_lancet, pal_list(), pal_other, pal_paraSC, pal_show_brewer(), pal_show_ggsci(), pal_show_hcl(), pal_show_viridis()

Examples

# Show specific palettes (gt table, default)
pal_show(c("lancet", "Paired", "viridis"))
